events.title: Mozilla 1.0 released
events.summary: The Mozilla Organization released Mozilla 1.0 on June 5, 2002 — the open-source browser suite descended from Netscape's code.
events.about: Mozilla 1.0 proved the Netscape open-source release could ship a full browser — spawning Firefox, Thunderbird, and the Gecko engine. Developers got a community-governed alternative to Internet Explorer during the browser wars' second act.

narrative.whyChosen: Mozilla 1.0 validated open-source browser development after Netscape's fall.
narrative.whyImportant: It led directly to Firefox and modern Gecko-based engines.
narrative.problemSolved: The web needed a maintained open browser codebase not controlled by one vendor.
